source: overlay, written 2026-11-26: sudo's listing gives ALL without a password, as a cloud image's first user has (90-cloud-init-users: pat ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL)

sudo.listing:
Matching Defaults entries for pat on Ubuntu:
    env_reset, mail_badpass,
    secure_path=/usr/local/sbin\:/usr/local/bin\:/usr/sbin\:/usr/bin\:/sbin\:/bin, use_pty

User pat may run the following commands on Ubuntu:
    (ALL : ALL) ALL
    (ALL) NOPASSWD: ALL
